scores.title: Sonata
demands: Maintain a fast compound pulse at dotted quarter = 140 while changing among 9/8, 6/8 and 12/8.
Alternate slurred figures with accented and staccato eighth notes through frequent accidentals and upper ledger-line pitches.
Coordinate independent piano entries and chromatic chords.
scores.scope: Composer preview, movement I opening music page 1 visually inspected. Image shows opening through bar 11. Later movements, complete range and endurance remain unknown.
scores.source_label: Aleks Sternfeld-Dunn, composer-hosted transposed score

scores.title: Zut!
demands: Opening marked Aggressively, quarter = 144, with trills, dense accidentals and a 5:4 figure.
Control sudden dynamic changes through very soft to ff, fff and ffff.
Read 8va passages and stacked saxophone noteheads; full performance instructions are needed to interpret the sonorities.
Coordinate dense piano chords and rapid runs.
scores.scope: Short opening excerpt on printed page 119 of ECM+ retrospective visually inspected. Complete score, technique instructions and full range were unavailable.
scores.source_label: ECM+ 20-year retrospective, composer-authorized score excerpt
scores.identity_caveat: Congress archive identifies an exact performance, but its blocked page and embedded recording were not verified. No playable recording link included.

scores.title: Concerto
demands: Allegro vivace, quarter = 132, with sustained sixteenth-note scale patterns and chromatic accidentals.
Alternate slurred and articulated figures, ties and accents without losing the orchestral pulse.
Enter after a string exposition and coordinate active string counterpoint.
scores.scope: Composer perusal score music pages 1 and 3 visually inspected. Image shows page 3, bars 27 onward. No full-work range audit.
scores.source_label: Christian Blaha, composer-hosted full-score perusal
scores.identity_caveat: Score is in concert pitch. Displayed saxophone notes do not establish written alto range. No piano reduction verified. Recording is composer-linked; no audition claimed.

scores.title: Shy One
demands: Shape a delicate 3/4 melody at quarter = 100, marked Moderato grazioso.
Integrate grace notes, breath commas and chromatic inflections into flowing eighth notes.
Coordinate rubato and fermata with the piano, then resume a tempo; follow segno and last-time coda instructions.
scores.scope: Wirripang one-page opening sample visually inspected. Image shows the opening two systems. Ending and complete range are unknown.
scores.source_label: Wirripang, publisher score sample
scores.identity_caveat: Publisher score spells the composer Dulcie Holland. Catalog spelling is retained pending correction C3.

scores.title: Annexus
scores.instrumentation: Alto saxophone and prepared piano (source scoring)
demands: Read spatially proportioned durations and time in seconds, including sustained notes indicated by extended beams.
Synchronize saxophone and piano events using vertical arrows.
Produce minor-second and quarter-tone lip glissandi with dynamic shaping in the inspected examples.
Dissertation reports prepared-piano setup, highest-possible altissimo gestures, growl or flutter tongue, and slow wide vibrato.
scores.scope: Authorized excerpts in Gregory E. Miller's UNT dissertation, printed pages 29 and 32, visually inspected. Image is Example 21, score page 6 system 2. Broader technique inventory is dissertation evidence; full 19-page score was not inspected.

scores.identity_caveat: Recording history is archival evidence only. No exact accessible audio link verified.

Notation legend requires timed rapid groups, variable rests, acceleration/deceleration, pitched breath sound and highest-possible tone.
